capabilities: Open a terminal at the current file's directory
Trigger opening from editor and file explorer context menus
Trigger opening from the command palette or a ribbon button
Configure which terminal application to launch
extras: Desktop-only (Windows or macOS); does not work on mobile. The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to launch a terminal in the directory of the note you are working in, forcing manual navigation in a separate terminal app.
summary: Utility that opens your preferred terminal application at the current file's or folder's directory via right-click menus, command palette, or ribbon.
